::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 18th 1864  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Birmingham City Archives, Birmingham Reference Library MS 135
:::

[Gentlemen](organizations/other_258.qmd),[^1]
I enclose the slip you have been so good as to forward to me - with a few corrections, to which I would wish to add that I have been the author of ‘the [Kings of England](cmy_books/cmybook_6.qmd),’ and of ‘Landmarks of History’ [‘] [Ancient](cmy_books/cmybook_14.qmd)’, ‘[Middle Ages](cmy_books/cmybook_16.qmd)’ and ‘[Modern](cmy_books/cmybook_28.qmd)’ being a compendium of Universal History for young people. I should prefer no statement being made as to the application of the proceeds of my publications

your obt servt
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The biographical dictionary referred to here was probably *Men of the Time* (7th ed. London: Routledge 1868), whose entry on CMY appears to correspond with this letter.
